name: Customer Support Ticket Triage | Ranime Jemal Agency

parameters.content:
## Customer Support Ticket Triage
Every support email is categorized (category, urgency, sentiment, language), summarized and logged as a ticket, with a suggested reply drafted in the same Gmail thread. Urgent and high-urgency tickets are emailed to the person on duty.
1. Fill in **Settings** (your real policies make the drafts better). 2. Make a sheet with a **Tickets** tab (`tickets-sheet.csv`). 3. Connect Gmail (support inbox), Google Sheets and OpenAI. 4. Activate.
